parameters.name: AdviceType
parameters.description:
The type of suggestions to return. Valid values:

- **INDEX**: index optimization.

- **TIERING**: data tiering.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> To query the IDs of AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters, call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) API.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end date of the query time range, in yyyyMMdd format and in UTC.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: A keyword for performing a fuzzy search by table name.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the suggestions. Valid values:

- **zh**: Simplified Chinese (default)

- **en**: English

- **ja**: Japanese

- **zh-tw**: Traditional Chinese

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the results. The value must be a JSON string, such as `[{"Field":"SchemaName","Type":"Asc"}]`. The JSON string contains the following fields:

- `Field`: The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

  - `SchemaName`: schema name.

  - `TableName`: table name.

  - `JobStatus`: Status of the table build job.

  - `SubmitTime`: Time when the suggestion was created.

  - `Benefit`: Expected optimization benefit.

- `Type`: the sort order. Valid values:

  - `Asc`: ascending order.

  - `Desc`: descending order.

> If this parameter is not specified, the results are sorted by creation time (`SubmitTime`) in descending order by default.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return per page. Valid values:

- **30** (default)

- **50**

- **100**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> To query available region IDs, call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) API.

parameters.name: SchemaTableName
parameters.description: The schema name and table name. The value must be in the **`<schema>.<table>`** format.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start date of the query time range, in yyyyMMdd format and in UTC.
